features.name: Primal Companion
features.desc: You summon a primal beast (Land, Sea, or Sky) as a companion with its own stat block. It acts on your turn; as a Bonus Action, you command it to attack or move. Its AC and Hit Points increase with your level; you summon it again after a rest or by expending a spell slot.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.desc: When the companion doesn't attack, it can take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action as a Bonus Action. Its attacks deal your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Force damage.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.desc: The companion makes two attacks when you command it to attack. If your Hunter's Mark is active, the companion adds its extra damage to its attacks.

features.name: Share Spells
features.desc: When you cast a spell with a range of Self, you can also have it affect your companion if it is within 30 feet.
